newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Ex-economy minister still has Russia govt role.
newsitem.headline: Ex-economy minister still has Russia govt role.

text.p: Former Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasin has been named a minister without portfolio in the new Russian government, Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin told a news conference on Wednesday.

Chernomyrdin said Alexei Kudrin, an ally of new First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais, was being appointed First Deputy Finance Minister. Chubais himself holds the finance portfolio in addition to his duties as one of two first deputy premiers.
"Yevgeny Yasin is now a minister...he will deal with economic questions, including coordinating work on our programmes, reviewing them and analysing them," Chernomyrdin told a news conference.
"Alexei Kudrin was appointed First Deputy Finance Minister."
Yasin has played a key role in negotiations between Russia and international financial organisations and with the Group of Seven industrialised countries.
